answer: Recovery needs approval from at least three of five named guardians, and even after the threshold is met the new key activates only after a 72-hour delay. The owner can cancel during that window, so an attacker must corrupt a majority of guardians and also silence the owner for three days, which makes a quick takeover infeasible. A lone oasis cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. When the ocean settles over the haven, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
